notes: The first *thy* goes to τοῦ under rule 76: σου is spent on *thine eye* and is not available to carry a second, distinct possessive; the case preposition rides with the article under rule 21.
φωτεινόν and σκοτεινόν head on *light* and *darkness*, the meaning-bearing words of *full of light* and *full of darkness*.
